MENU_QUICK_DESC: Naziphi na izizwe ezimbini, nayiphi na indawo. I-centre pass yeyakho.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Izizwe ezi-8, amaqoqo amabini, ii-semi-final nomdlalo wamagqibela.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Ibala, izikhundla ezisixhenxe nayo yonke imithetho ebizwa ngoompempe.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Umdlalo wokwenyani uneekota ezine zemizuzu eli-15. Iwotshi iyaqhubeka nangona kufakwa amanqaku, ime kuphela xa kukho ukwenzakala.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Umthetho weligi: kwimizuzu emihlanu yokugqibela yekota nganye, inqaku elifakwe ukusuka kwi-3 m nangaphezulu libalwa kabini.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Abakhuseli babo bacotha ukufunda iipasi zakho, kwaye kunqabile ukuba baxhwile enye.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Iqela elihle leklabhu: lixhwila ipasi engalunganga.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Iqela lamazwe ngamazwe: likhawuleza ukufunda umdlalo, kunzima ukudlula kulo.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Abona bagqwesileyo ehlabathini. Ipasi yobuvila iyaxhwilwa.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: Udlala nabani na onebhola, kunye nomkhuseli okufutshane nayo.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Iqela: ulawula nabani na onebhola. Isikhundla esinye: khetha i-bib kwisikrini sasekhaya uze umdlale umdlalo wonke, njengoko umdlali esenza.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Ivuliwe: umdlali wakho uyema emdeni weendawo isikhundla sakhe esivumelekileyo ukungena kuzo. Ivaliwe: nyathela ngaphaya komgca, ompempe abize i-offside.
POS_ROLE_GA: Ufaka amanqaku, uphakela uGoal Shooter aze aqhubele phambili kwisahlulo esiphakathi.
POS_ROLE_WA: Uphakela isangqa esemdeni waso; ukhetho lokuqala kwi-centre pass.
POS_ROLE_C: Uthatha i-centre pass aze adibanise ukukhusela nokuhlasela kulo lonke ibala.
POS_ROLE_WD: Ulinda uWing Attack aze avale ipasi engena esangqeni.
POS_ROLE_GD: Ulinda uGoal Attack, ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesangqa.
POS_ROLE_GK: Ulinda uGoal Shooter, ukhusela ukufaka aze abambe ibhola ebuyayo.
POS_AREAS_GA: Iindawo: isahlulo esiphakathi, isahlulo sokuhlasela nesangqa senqaku.
POS_AREAS_WA: Iindawo: isahlulo esiphakathi nesahlulo sokuhlasela, hayi isangqa.
POS_AREAS_C: Iindawo: zonke izahlulo ezintathu, akukho sangqa.
POS_AREAS_WD: Iindawo: isahlulo esiphakathi nesahlulo sokukhusela, hayi isangqa.
POS_AREAS_GD: Iindawo: isahlulo esiphakathi, isahlulo sokukhusela nesangqa senqaku.
GFX_NOTE: Ezantsi kulungele iifowuni ezingabizi kakhulu: akukho mida, isihlwele esincinci. Xa okuzenzekelayo kuvuliwe, umdlalo ohamba kancinci kwimizuzwana yokuqala uthoba inqanaba ngokwawo.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Malunga neefreyimu ezi-{n} ngomzuzwana, zizotywe zincinci kancinci: ifowuni ipholile, ibhetri ihlala ixesha elide.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Iifreyimu ezi-{n} ngomzuzwana kwisikrini sakho se-{hz} Hz: kugudile, kwaye kutya ibhetri kancinci kunobuninzi.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Zonke iifreyimu isikrini sakho se-{hz} Hz esinokuzibonisa.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Rhuqa iqhosha ngalinye ulise apho ubhontsi wakho ulifumana khona. Aya kuhlala apho.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Umdlalo ozimeleyo. Amaqela ngamazwe abizwa ngamagama awo aqhelekileyo; onke amagama abadlali ayilwe. Awunxulumananga nawuphi na umbutho olawulayo, iligi okanye ukhuphiswano.
LICENCES_INTRO: Lo mdlalo wakhiwe ngesoftware yasimahla nevulelekileyo. Iilayisenisi zayo zicela ukuba ezi ngxelo ziboniswe; zisesiNgesini, njengoko zabhalwa.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Ubude buyi-30,5 m, ububanzi buyi-15,25 m, lahlulwe izahlulo ezintathu. Embindini kukho isangqa esiphakathi esiyi-0,9 m ububanzi, kwaye esiphelweni ngasinye kukho isangqa senqaku: isiqingatha sesangqa esiyi-4,9 m ukusuka kwipali. Iringi iphakame nge-3,05 m, ayinayo ibhodi.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Umdlali ngamnye unxiba i-bib enesikhundla sakhe, kwaye angangena kuphela kwiindawo zesikhundla sakhe. Iqela lichaza abadlali ukuya kwishumi elinesibini; utshintsho lwenziwa ngamakhefu, emva kwenqaku xa kucelwa, nangenxa yokwenzakala.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: NguGoal Shooter noGoal Attack kuphela abanokufaka inqaku, kwaye kuphela ngaphakathi kwesangqa senqaku. Ibhola mayidlule ngokupheleleyo kwiringi. Ukufaka okuphume ezandleni zakhe ngaphambi kwempempe kuyabalwa.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Ikota nganye iqala nge-centre pass, kunjalo nomdlalo emva kwenqaku ngalinye. Amaqela ayatshintshana, nokuba ngubani ofake inqaku. UCentre umi kwisangqa esiphakathi; abanye balinda kwizahlulo zabo zenqaku de kuvuthelwe impempe, kwaye ipasi mayibanjwe kwisahlulo esiphakathi.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Iikota ezine zemizuzu eli-15, nemizuzu emine phakathi kwekota yokuqala neyesibini, naphakathi kweyesithathu neyesine, kunye nemizuzu elishumi elinesibini kwikhefu eliphakathi. Amaqela atshintsha amacala kwikota nganye.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Xa umdlalo kufuneka ube nophumeleleyo kodwa amaqela alingana: izahlulo ezimbini ezide ukuya kwimizuzu esixhenxe nomzuzu omnye phakathi kwazo, emva koko umdlalo uyaqhubeka de iqela elinye likhokele ngamanqaku amabini.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Xa ephethe ibhola akavumelekanga ukubaleka. Unyawo ahlala ngalo lunyawo lwakhe lokuhla: angathatha inyathelo ngolunye unyawo aze ajikeleze kulo, kodwa xa eluphakamisile, kufuneka agqithise okanye afake ngaphambi kokuba luchukumise umgangatho kwakhona. Ipasi yasimahla kwelinye iqela.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Kufuneka agqithise okanye afake kwimizuzwana emithathu emva kokubamba ibhola. Ukubambelela ebholeni: ipasi yasimahla.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Umkhuseli ozama ukuvala okanye ukuthatha ibhola kufuneka eme ubuncinane kwi-0,9 m ukusuka kunyawo lokuhla lomdlali onebhola. Ukuba usondele ngaphezu koko, kukuthintela: ipasi yesohlwayo.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Akukho kuchukumisana kuphazamisa umdlalo womchasi: ukutyhala, ukubamba, ukubetha ibhola iphume ezandleni zakhe, okanye ukungamniki indawo yokuhla umdlali ofumene ibhola. Ipasi yesohlwayo.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Umdlali ongena kwindawo isikhundla sakhe esingavumelekanga ukungena kuyo, enebhola okanye engenayo, use-offside. Imigca iyinxalenye yeendawo ezijikelezwe yiyo. Ipasi yasimahla.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Ibhola ayivumelekanga ukuphoswa ngaphezu kwesahlulo siphela ngaphandle kokuba umdlali okweso sahlulo ayibambe okanye ayichukumise. Ipasi yasimahla.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Kufuneka kubekho indawo yokuba umchasi axhwile ibhola phakathi komphosi nombambi. Ipasi yasimahla.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Ibhola ewela ngaphandle kwebala inikwa iqela elingayichukumisanga lokugqibela: i-throw-in ukusuka apho iwele khona umgca, eyenziwa kwimizuzwana emithathu.
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Ipasi yasimahla yenziwa apho impazamo yenzeke khona, nguye nawuphi na umdlali ovumelekileyo ukuba alapho. Kwipasi yesohlwayo, umdlali ohlwaywayo umi ecaleni komphosi, engadlali, de ibhola ikhululwe. Kwisangqa senqaku, isohlwayo singaba yipasi okanye ukufaka.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Umpempe uvumela umdlalo uqhubeke xa ukuwumisa bekuya kulimaza iqela elonelweyo: umzekelo, umfaki osele eza kufaka. Ubiza inzuzo kunye nempazamo.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Ngokudlala okuphindaphindiweyo okanye okuyingozi, umpempe angalumkisa umdlali, amnqumamise imizuzu emibini yexesha lokudlala, okanye amkhuphe ebaleni. Ukususela ngo-2024 akusekho toss-up: xa abadlali ababini bephazama ngaxeshanye, iqela ebeligqibele ukuba nebhola liyayigcina.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Ezinye iiligi zidlala ngeenguqu. Lo mdlalo unika i-Double Zone: kwimizuzu emihlanu yokugqibela yekota nganye, inqaku elifakwe kwi-3 m nangaphezulu ukusuka kwipali libalwa kabini.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Ubhontsi wasekhohlo naphi na kwicala lasekhohlo lesikrini yijoystick: ubalekisa umdlali wakho (iringi eluhlaza okhanyayo). Baleka uye kwindawo evulekileyo ukuze ukhululeke ufumane ipasi.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Xa ephethe ibhola akakwazi ukubaleka. Tyhala induku ujonge kumdlali weqela lakho ukuze umkhethe (iringi ibonisa ukuba ngubani), emva koko GQITHISA ukwenzela ipasi yesifuba okanye yegxalaba, okanye PHEZULU ukudlula phezu komkhuseli. Iringi ephezu kwebhola yimizuzwana yakho emithathu.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: FAKA iyavela xa uGoal Shooter okanye uGoal Attack wakho enebhola esangqeni. Ukusondela kuqinisekisa ngakumbi; ingalo yomkhuseli phezu kwebhola yenza kube nzima.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: KHUSELA iphakamisa iingalo zakho phezu kwebhola. Jonga iringi ejikeleze unyawo lwakhe lokuhla: eluhlaza ivumelekile, ebomvu isondele ngaphezu kwe-0,9 m kwaye umpempe uya kubiza ukuthintela.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: XHWILA itsibela ipasi esemoyeni ukuba unokufikelela kuyo ngexesha. Ukuba utsibela umdlali ophethe ibhola, kukuchukumisana.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Xa udlala njengeqela, ulawula nabani na onebhola, kwaye TSHINTSHA ikusa kumkhuseli okufutshane nayo. Khetha i-bib kwisikrini sasekhaya ukuze udlale isikhundla esinye umdlalo wonke.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD okanye iintolo ukuhamba, Space kwiqhosha lokuqala, J no-K kwamanye, Esc ukunqumamisa.
INTERVAL_NOTE: Ikhefu limizuzu eyi-{min}; Qhubeka iqala {next} ngoku.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Cofa isikhundla ukuze ungenise umdlali olandelayo ebhentshini osidlalayo.
CUP_ABOUT: Izizwe ezisibhozo ezikufutshane nelakho kuluhlu lwamanqanaba ehlabathi, kumaqoqo amabini ezine. Ezimbini eziphezulu kwiqoqo ngalinye ziya kwii-semi-final; emva koko owamagqibela nomdlalo wobhedu. Amanqaku amabini ngokuphumelela, elinye ngokulingana; ukulingana kwahlulwa yipesenti yamanqaku afakiweyo.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Dlala umdlalo, iirekhodi zakho ziqale apha.
